lines.t: (soft ambient pads, distant shimmer)
From sunset… to sunset…
We rest in You…
Those who remember, honor Your name
Those who are still find rest in Your flame
Hearts set on the coming Day
Quiet souls, You lead the way
In sacred stillness, we draw near
Your presence washes every fear
In gentle light, our spirits stay
Held within Your holy Day
We cherish the Sabbath, we breathe You in
Lift up thanksgiving again and again
Washed in the Word, made new in Your light
Resting in peace through the fall of night
Softly You call, and we obey
Dwelling in grace, we remain
From sunset to sunset, we find our place
Covered in mercy, surrounded by grace
Let only beauty flow from our hearts
Praise rising pure, set apart
In quiet reverence, we stand
Held by the work of Your hand
Gentleness walks where striving ends
Humility, our closest friend
In stillness, deeper we see
You are our peace, eternally
We cherish the Sabbath, we breathe You in
Lift up thanksgiving again and again
Washed in the Word, made new in Your light
Resting in peace through the fall of night
Softly You call, and we obey
Dwelling in grace, we remain
From sunset to sunset, we find our place
Covered in mercy, surrounded by grace
Let Your grace be our covering
Let every heart be still
No striving, no fear, no wandering
Only Your perfect will
Drifting in holy calm
Carried by unseen hands
Rest for the soul, forever known
Held in Your command
